name: perform-ai
description:
Perform AI MCP gives your AI assistant direct access to your delivery and post-purchase data - the same data behind our web portal, available conversationally. 

The connector provides capabilities such as: segment shipments across your full filter catalog, drill into any parcel, replay a saved portal view as a live query, and check carrier coverage and configuration.

The connector expands as the platform does, across post-purchase, checkout, returns, and logistics. Every capability your team reaches for on the portal should be reachable by an agent here, bounded by the same permission controls.

defaultPrompt: Which carriers had the most delayed deliveries to Germany in July 2026?
Walk me through everything that happened to shipment SHIP98941311 and tell me where it stalled.
Check our active carrier configs and flag any that are unused.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments are performed through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial production release of the Perform.AI read-only MCP connection at https://mcp.perform.ai/mcp-invoke. Includes OAuth authentication, shipment and carrier workflows through invoke_method_read, five positive and three negative review cases attached to the MCP server, and a supplied demo recording. Production draft validation remains pending.
